about_short_description.short_description: Olive Gaea is a climate tech company driving sustainability action through AI-powered solutions. nization and ESG leadership.

product.name: DIGITAL Zero
product.description: An AI-driven platform for end-to-end carbon management including measurement, monitoring, reduction, offsetting, and reporting of greenhouse gas emissions.

product.name: DIGITAL CARBON NEUTRAL API
product.description: An API solution enabling businesses to integrate real-time carbon footprint measurement and customer-driven carbon offsetting into their platforms.

product.name: Zero for Events
product.description: A platform to track, analyze, and optimize the environmental impact of events, covering aspects like materials, transportation, and carbon offsetting.

product.name: Automated ESG Reporting
product.description: A tool to automate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) reporting, ensuring compliance with international frameworks and broadening reporting beyond greenhouse gas emissions.

product.name: Consulting Services
product.description: Customized consulting for carbon management, net zero roadmap development, carbon offsetting, life cycle assessment, and sustainability strategy.
